recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition split vertically between a brushed aluminum texture on the left and a desaturated, sepia-toned photograph of a woman in a black gown standing in the doorway of a vintage Airstream trailer on the right. The design features a border of sparkling rhinestones and bold, condensed sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between industrial metallic textures and soft human skin tones
Vertical division separating abstract graphic space from narrative photographic space
Repetition of circular motifs in the brushed metal and the rhinestone borders
Tonal harmony between the silver metal and the desaturated photographic palette
coreInvariants: Brushed circular metal texture with a central highlight
Airstream-style riveted aluminum trailer as the primary setting
Desaturated, warm-grey or sepia color grading on the photographic element
Rhinestone/diamond border detailing along the edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The human subject is positioned in the right two-thirds of the frame, framed by the trailer door, standing at full height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright circular highlight on the brushed metal panel acts as the primary visual anchor for the text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright metal highlight, moves down through the stacked typography, then follows the subject's leg and gaze into the trailer interior.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The left third of the image is dedicated negative space for branding, utilizing a radial brushed metal effect.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Black (Subject's dress and interior shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the metallic highlights and deep shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Tall x-height with elongated vertical proportions
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'I' in the secondary line features a small diamond/rhinestone dot instead of a standard tittle.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying weights or colors to distinguish hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Rhinestone border along the left and bottom edges
Winged rhinestone emblem at the bottom center

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the tall, flat-sided condensed aesthetic.
Similar weight and condensed nature, though less refined.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a split-screen image. The left side is a radial brushed aluminum texture with a bright central highlight. The right side is a desaturated, sepia-toned photo of a blonde woman in a black evening gown standing in the doorway of a vintage silver Airstream trailer. Add a border of individual sparkling rhinestones along the left and bottom edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply two lines of large, white, extra-condensed sans-serif text in the top left. Apply a third line of text below it in a darker grey tone. Ensure the text is stacked vertically with tight spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the photo desaturated to a sepia/grey tone?
Are the rhinestone borders visible and sparkling?
Is the font tall and condensed?

adjustableVariables: Width of the metal panel vs. the photo panel
Brightness of the radial metallic highlight
mustRedesign: Identifiable brand names on the trailer
postGenerationChecks: Check that the rhinestone border does not look like a solid line.
Ensure the brushed metal grain follows a circular path.
Verify the subject's dress is deep black to provide contrast.
Confirm the text is perfectly aligned to the left.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Industrial Texture] + [Desaturated Fashion Portrait] + [Jeweled Accents] + [Condensed Typography] for a 'Modern Country Glamour' aesthetic.
